title: The Sleeping Choir
author: Isandro Joubert
blurb: Wendell Reyes, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the last resident signs the papers.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
